user.title: Fix-It Lens
user.description: The address of your Fix-It Lens and a token your home made for Home Assistant. Make one that can write so ticking a job off works.

hassio_confirm.title: Fix-It Lens
hassio_confirm.description: The Fix-It Lens add-on made a key for one of its homes. Add it to see that home's upkeep jobs here, tick them off and snooze them.

reauth_confirm.title: Fix-It Lens
reauth_confirm.description: Fix-It Lens refused the token (revoked, or the home was deleted). Make a new one and paste it here.

discover.title: Appliances Home Assistant knows
discover.description: Tick the ones to add to your Fix-It Lens home. Only each ticked one's maker, model, kind and name are sent. A model Fix-It Lens has a checked card for links it at once; any other gets its manual's pages, and its card is made on request. Tick none to add none.

error.cannot_connect: Fix-It Lens did not answer at that address.
error.read_only: This token can only read, so it cannot add appliances. Make one that can write, or tick none.

abort.already_configured: This household is already set up.
abort.invalid_auth: Fix-It Lens refused the key the add-on sent. Press Connect again in the add-on's panel.
abort.cannot_connect: The Fix-It Lens add-on did not answer. Check that it is running.

mark_done.name: Mark done
mark_done.description: Marks a Fix-It Lens job done, today or on a past date. The next date follows from the manual or your own schedule.

job.name: Job
job.description: The job, as its next-due sensor's `job` attribute or the fixit_lens_job_due event gives it.

date.name: Date
date.description: The day it was done. Leave empty for today.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Moves a Fix-It Lens job's due date later. It never moves a date earlier.

job.name: Job
job.description: The job, as its next-due sensor's `job` attribute or the fixit_lens_job_due event gives it.

until.name: Until
until.description: The new due date, after the one it has now.

days.name: Days
days.description: Or: this many days after the date it is due now (or today, if it is overdue).

error.read_only: This token can only read, so it cannot add appliances. Make one that can write, or tick none.
error.cannot_connect: Fix-It Lens did not answer at that address.

abort.nothing_found: Home Assistant knows no appliance that your Fix-It Lens home does not have yet.
